Module io.github.brantunger.unruly.core
Package io.github.brantunger.unruly.api.language

Interface ExpressionCompiler

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
public interface ExpressionCompiler extends AutoCloseable
Compiles the conditions and actions of one rule list, checks the names of the facts they run against, and creates the sessions they run with.

RulesEngine.load(java.util.List) calls the compile methods on one thread, and then, for an engine built with copiesAtLoad(n), newSession() and warmUp(Session) on the same thread. checkFactName(String) and newSession() are also called by runs of the rule list, possibly on many threads at once, so they must be thread-safe.

The engine closes the compiler once it no longer needs the rule list, after closing every session the compiler created: when a later load() has replaced the rule list and no run is still using it, when the engine is closed, or when the rule list fails to load.

Implemented by expression languages. A method added to this interface is a default method, so an existing language keeps compiling and working.

See Also:

  • Method Details

    • compileCondition

      CompiledCondition compileCondition(Expression source)
      Compiles a condition. A condition must evaluate to a Boolean, and can't change facts or declare variables; a compiler that can see such a write rejects the condition here.
      Parameters:
      source - The condition: the name of its rule, CONDITION, and its text, which isn't blank
      Returns:
      The compiled condition, which every run of the rule list shares. Keep what changes while it runs in a Session.
      Throws:
      InvalidExpressionException - if the condition breaks a rule the engine enforces, such as assigning to a fact, or has an error the language can point to, such as a syntax error; its issues say where. Anything else is reported as the cause of a RuleCompilationException too.

    • compileAction

      CompiledAction compileAction(Expression source)
      Compiles an action. When it runs, the action either changes the output object it sees as "output" and returns ActionResult.done(), or returns ActionResult.set(java.util.Map) with the properties for the engine to set on the output object.
      Parameters:
      source - The action: the name of its rule, ACTION, and its text, which isn't blank
      Returns:
      The compiled action, which every run of the rule list shares. Keep what changes while it runs in a Session.
      Throws:
      InvalidExpressionException - if the action breaks a rule the engine enforces, or has an error the language can point to, such as a syntax error; its issues say where. Anything else is reported as the cause of a RuleCompilationException too.

    • newSession

      Session newSession()
      Creates a session for one copy of the rule list: the state this language's conditions and actions change while they run. Every condition and action this compiler compiled is given the session of the run that evaluates it.
      Returns:
      A new session, or Session.none() if the compiled expressions keep no state between runs and are safe to run on several threads at once. Throwing or returning null fails the run that needed the session with a RuleExecutionException.

    • warmUp

      default void warmUp(Session session) throws Exception
      Prepares a new session before any run uses it, such as by compiling this compiler's expressions into it, so that the runs that use it first don't pay for that. By default, does nothing: a session prepares itself the first time each expression runs, whatever that costs.

      RulesEngine.load(java.util.List) calls it on its own thread, once for each session it creates with newSession() for a copy made when the rules load (RulesEngineBuilder.copiesAtLoad(int)), after compiling every expression and before any run uses the session. It isn't called for Session.none(), or for a session created during a run, which prepares itself as it's used.

      Parameters:
      session - A session this compiler's newSession() returned, which no run has used
      Throws:
      Exception - if the session can't be prepared. It fails load() with a RuleCompilationException naming the language, and the rules loaded before stay loaded, except a fatal Error, which is rethrown unchanged.

    • checkFactName

      default void checkFactName(String name)
      Rejects the name of a fact that rules written in this language couldn't refer to, such as a keyword of the language. The engine has already rejected "output" and null. By default, every other name is accepted.
      Parameters:
      name - The fact's name
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if rules can't refer to a fact with this name; run() throws it as is. Anything else this method throws is logged and thrown from run() as an IllegalArgumentException naming the fact and the language, except a fatal Error, which is rethrown unchanged.

    • close

      default void close()
      Releases what the compiler holds. The engine calls it once, after closing every session the compiler created. By default, does nothing. An exception it throws is logged at WARN and not thrown, except a fatal Error, which is rethrown unchanged.
      Specified by:
      close in interface AutoCloseable
